This notebook evaluates whether a Combine speed-building measurement adds information about a defined NFL movement outcome.

The working question: Does Combine speed buildup add information about how quickly receivers gain speed on rookie-season NFL GO routes, beyond official 40 time and 10-yard split?

## Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

ROOT <- normalizePath(getwd())

while (!(dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "analysis_r")) &&
         dir.exists(file.path(ROOT, "data")))) {

  parent <- dirname(ROOT)

  if (parent == ROOT) {
    stop("Open the project folder first.")
  }

  ROOT <- parent
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = ROOT)
```

```{r check-nfl-keys}
audit_keys <- function(data, keys, table_name) {

  missing_key <- !complete.cases(
    data[, keys, drop = FALSE]
  )

  complete_keys <- data[
    !missing_key,
    keys,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  duplicate_key <- duplicated(complete_keys) |
    duplicated(complete_keys, fromLast = TRUE)

  tibble(
    table = table_name,
    rows = nrow(data),
    missing_key_rows = sum(missing_key),
    duplicate_key_rows = sum(duplicate_key)
  )
}

nfl_key_audit <- bind_rows(
  audit_keys(
    games,
    keys = "game_id",
    table_name = "games"
  ),
  audit_keys(
    player_play,
    keys = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id"),
    table_name = "player_play"
  )
)

nfl_key_audit

if (any(nfl_key_audit$missing_key_rows > 0L) ||
    any(nfl_key_audit$duplicate_key_rows > 0L)) {
  stop("Review NFL key problems before joining.")
}
```

## Match the Combine cohort to NFL records

```{r join-nfl-metadata}
cohort_player_plays <- player_play |>
  semi_join(
    player_roster,
    by = "nfl_id"
  )

unmatched_games <- cohort_player_plays |>
  distinct(game_id) |>
  anti_join(
    games,
    by = "game_id"
  )

if (nrow(unmatched_games) > 0L) {
  stop("Some cohort plays have no matching game metadata.")
}

cohort_player_plays <- cohort_player_plays |>
  left_join(
    games |>
      select(
        game_id,
        season,
        season_type
      ),
    by = "game_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    player_roster |>
      select(
        nfl_id,
        draft_year,
        display_name,
        combine_position,
        nfl_position
      ),
    by = "nfl_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )
```

## Rookie regular-season opportunities

```{r rookie-regular-season}
rookie_player_plays <- cohort_player_plays |>
  filter(
    season == draft_year,
    season_type == "REG"
  )

player_opportunities <- rookie_player_plays |>
  group_by(draft_year, nfl_id) |>
  summarise(
    rookie_player_plays = n(),

    go_routes = sum(
      route_ran == "GO",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    go_routes_without_motion = sum(
      route_ran == "GO" &
        in_motion_at_ball_snap == "FALSE",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

opportunity_roster <- player_roster |>
  left_join(
    player_opportunities,
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        rookie_player_plays,
        go_routes,
        go_routes_without_motion
      ),
      ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)
    )
  )

nfl_coverage <- opportunity_roster |>
  group_by(combine_position, draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    combine_players = n(),

    players_with_rookie_rows = sum(
      rookie_player_plays > 0L
    ),

    players_with_go_routes = sum(
      go_routes > 0L
    ),

    players_with_nonmotion_go_routes = sum(
      go_routes_without_motion > 0L
    ),

    nonmotion_go_routes = sum(
      go_routes_without_motion
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(combine_position, draft_year)

print(nfl_coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r receiver-route-labels}
receiver_rookie_rows |>

```

```{r go-route-concept}
receiver_go_routes <- receiver_rookie_rows |>
  filter(route_ran == "GO")

receiver_go_routes |>
  count(
    in_motion_at_ball_snap,
    name = "player_plays",
    sort = TRUE
  )

receiver_go_routes |>
  count(
    lined_up_position,
    name = "player_plays",
    sort = TRUE
  )

receiver_go_routes |>
  count(
    play_nullified_by_penalty,
    name = "player_plays",
    sort = TRUE
  )
```

These are player-play opportunity counts, not measured movement outcomes. Unknown motion values have not been interpreted as stationary, and tracking/event coverage has not yet been checked.

Rookie season is defined here as the NFL season matching the recorded draft year. Combine position defines the initial cohort; NFL position and lined-up role remain available for review.

## Define candidate receiver routes

```{r route-eligibility}
route_eligibility <- receiver_go_routes |>
  mutate(
    eligibility_status = case_when(
      is.na(lined_up_position) ~
        "Missing lined-up position",

      !lined_up_position %in% c("WR", "SLOT_WR") ~
        "Other lined-up role",

      is.na(in_motion_at_ball_snap) ~
        "Missing motion value",

      in_motion_at_ball_snap == "TRUE" ~
        "In motion at snap",

      in_motion_at_ball_snap != "FALSE" ~
        "Unrecognized motion value",

      is.na(play_nullified_by_penalty) ~
        "Missing penalty status",

      play_nullified_by_penalty != "N" ~
        "Play nullified or unrecognized penalty status",

      TRUE ~
        "Candidate route"
    )
  )

eligibility_summary <- route_eligibility |>
  count(
    eligibility_status,
    name = "player_plays",
    sort = TRUE
  )

eligibility_summary

candidate_routes <- route_eligibility |>
  filter(
    eligibility_status == "Candidate route"
  )

if (nrow(candidate_routes) == 0L) {
  stop("No routes meet the candidate definition.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(
  candidate_routes[, c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")]
) > 0L) {
  stop("Candidate route keys are not unique.")
}
```

## Read matching tracking frames in chunks

```{r tracking-frame-in-chunks}
read_candidate_tracking <- function(
    file,
    route_keys,
    source_season,
    chunk_size = 100000L) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id",
    "time", "x", "y", "s", "event"
  )

  header <- names(
    read_csv(
      file,
      n_max = 0,
      col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  )

  if (length(setdiff(required_columns, header)) > 0L) {
    stop("Required tracking columns are missing.")
  }

  matched_chunks <- list()
  rows_scanned <- 0

  callback <- SideEffectChunkCallback$new(
    function(chunk, position) {

      if (nrow(problems(chunk)) > 0L) {
        stop("CSV parsing problems found. Review the tracking file.")
      }

      rows_scanned <<- rows_scanned + nrow(chunk)

      matched <- chunk |>
        semi_join(
          route_keys,
          by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")
        )

      if (nrow(matched) > 0L) {
        matched$tracking_file_season <- source_season
        matched_chunks[[length(matched_chunks) + 1L]] <<- matched
      }
    }
  )

  read_csv_chunked(
    file,
    callback = callback,
    chunk_size = chunk_size,
    col_types = cols_only(
      game_id = col_character(),
      play_id = col_character(),
      nfl_id = col_character(),
      time = col_character(),
      x = col_character(),
      y = col_character(),
      s = col_character(),
      event = col_character()
    ),
    na = c("", "NA", "<NA>"),
    progress = FALSE,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  frames <- bind_rows(matched_chunks)

  list(
    frames = frames,
    summary = tibble(
      season = source_season,
      rows_scanned = rows_scanned,
      matched_frames = nrow(frames)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r retrieve-candidate-tracking}
tracking_results <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(tracking_files)),
  function(i) {

    season_value <- tracking_files$season[i]

    season_route_keys <- candidate_routes |>
      filter(season == season_value) |>
      distinct(
        game_id,
        play_id,
        nfl_id
      )

    message("Reading tracking for season ", season_value)

    read_candidate_tracking(
      file = tracking_files$file[i],
      route_keys = season_route_keys,
      source_season = season_value
    )
  }
)

matched_tracking <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    tracking_results,
    function(result) result$frames
  )
)

tracking_read_summary <- bind_rows(

    tracking_results,
    function(result) result$summary
  )
)

tracking_read_summary

if (nrow(matched_tracking) == 0L) {

}
```

## Audit each candidate route

```{r route-tracking-audit}
audit_route_tracking <- function(data) {
  valid_times <- data$timestamp[
    !is.na(data$timestamp)
  ]

  duplicate_rows <- sum(
    duplicated(valid_times) |
      duplicated(valid_times, fromLast = TRUE)
  )

  ordered_times <- sort(valid_times)

  elapsed_s <- if (length(ordered_times) > 0L) {
    round(
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          ordered_times,
          ordered_times[1],
          units = "secs"
        )
      ),
      digits = 6
    )
  } else {
    numeric(0)
  }


  steps_s <- diff(elapsed_s)

  snap_rows <- which(
      data$event == "ball_snap"
    )

    pass_rows <- which(
      data$event == "pass_forward"
    )

    snap_to_pass_s <- NA_real_

  if (length(snap_rows) == 1L &&
      length(pass_rows) == 1L &&
      !is.na(data$timestamp[snap_rows]) &&
      !is.na(data$timestamp[pass_rows])) {

    snap_to_pass_s <- as.numeric(
      difftime(
        data$timestamp[pass_rows],
        data$timestamp[snap_rows],
        units = "secs"
      )
    )
  }
  tibble(
    tracking_frames = nrow(data),

    invalid_timestamp_frames = sum(
      is.na(data$timestamp)
    ),

    duplicate_timestamp_rows = duplicate_rows,

    invalid_speed_frames = sum(
      !is.finite(data$speed_raw)
    ),

    negative_speed_frames = sum(
      data$speed_raw < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    intervals_outside_0_1_s = sum(
      abs(steps_s - 0.1) > 0.001
    ),

    snap_events = length(snap_rows),

    pass_events = length(pass_rows),

    snap_to_pass_s = snap_to_pass_s
  )
}
```

## Measure first-second speed gain

```{r movement-outcome-function}
measure_first_second_gain <- function(data) {
  
  data <- data |>
    arrange(timestamp)
  
  unavailable <- function(reason) {
    tibble(
      outcome_status = reason,
      snap_speed_raw = NA_real_,
      speed_at_one_second_raw = NA_real_,
      first_second_speed_gain_raw = NA_real_,
      snap_to_pass_s = NA_real_
    )
  }
  
  if (anyNA(data$timestamp) ||
      any(!is.finite(data$speed_raw)) ||
      any(data$speed_raw < 0)) {
    return(unavailable("Invalid tracking values"))
  }
  
  if (anyDuplicated(data$timestamp) > 0L) {
    return(unavailable("Duplicate timestamps"))
  }
  
  snap_rows <- which(data$event == "ball_snap")
  pass_rows <- which(data$event == "pass_forward")
  
  if (length(snap_rows) != 1L) {
    return(unavailable("Missing or multiple snap events"))
  }

  if (length(pass_rows) != 1L) {
    return(unavailable("Missing or multiple pass events"))
  }
  
  time_from_snap_s <- round(
    as.numeric(
      difftime(
        data$timestamp,
        data$timestamp[snap_rows],
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    digits = 6
  )
  
  pass_time_s <- time_from_snap_s[pass_rows]
  
  if (pass_time_s < 1 - 1e-6) {
    return(unavailable("Pass before one-second horizon"))
  }

  one_second_rows <- which(
    abs(time_from_snap_s - 1) <= 1e-6
  )

  if (length(one_second_rows) != 1L) {
    return(unavailable("No unique observed one-second frame"))
  }

  window_rows <- which(
    time_from_snap_s >= 0 &
      time_from_snap_s <= 1
  )

  window_steps <- diff(
    time_from_snap_s[window_rows]
  )

  if (length(window_rows) != 11L ||
      any(abs(window_steps - 0.1) > 0.001)) {
    return(unavailable("Incomplete first-second tracking"))
  }

  snap_speed <- data$speed_raw[snap_rows]
  one_second_speed <- data$speed_raw[one_second_rows]

  tibble(
    outcome_status = "Measured",
    snap_speed_raw = snap_speed,
    speed_at_one_second_raw = one_second_speed,
    first_second_speed_gain_raw =
      one_second_speed - snap_speed,
    snap_to_pass_s = pass_time_s
  )
}
```

```{r calculating-route-outcomes}
movement_by_route <- matched_tracking |>
  group_by(across(all_of(tracking_keys))) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ measure_first_second_gain(.x)

  ungroup()

route_outcomes <- candidate_routes |>
  left_join(
    movement_by_route,

print(outcome_status_summary, n = Inf)
```

## Summarize NFL movement by player

```{r player-movement}
player_nfl_movement <- measured_routes |>
  group_by(draft_year, nfl_id) |>
  summarise(
    measured_route_count = n(),

    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw = mean(
      first_second_speed_gain_raw
    ),

    sd_nfl_speed_gain_raw = sd(
      first_second_speed_gain_raw
    ),

    mean_snap_speed_raw = mean(
      snap_speed_raw
    ),

    slot_route_share = mean(
      lined_up_position == "SLOT_WR"
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Summarize Combine intervals by player

```{r player-combine-intervals}
player_combine_intervals <- named_intervals |>
  group_by(draft_year, nfl_id) |>
  summarise(
    combine_recording_count = n(),

    measured_combine_intervals = sum(
      status == "Measured"
  ),
  
  mean_combine_interval_s = if (
    any(status == "Measured")
  ) {
    mean(interval_s[status == "Measured"])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  },
  
  combine_interval_range_s = if (
      sum(status == "Measured") >= 2L
    ) {
      max(interval_s[status == "Measured"]) -
        min(interval_s[status == "Measured"])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Define the working modeling cohort

```{r working-model-cohort}
min_routes <- 10L

analysis_roster <- player_roster |>
  filter(combine_position == "WR") |>
  mutate(
    official_forty_s = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(forty)
    ),
    official_ten_split_s = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(ten_yd_split)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    player_combine_intervals,
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    player_nfl_movement,
    by = c("draft_year", "nfl_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    measured_route_count = coalesce(
      measured_route_count,
      0L
    ),

    analysis_status = case_when(
      measured_route_count == 0L ~
        "No measured NFL routes",

      measured_route_count < min_routes ~
        "Below NFL route threshold",

      is.na(measured_combine_intervals) |
        measured_combine_intervals < 1L |
        !is.finite(mean_combine_interval_s) ~
        "No measured Combine interval",

      !is.finite(official_forty_s) |
        official_forty_s <= 0 |
        !is.finite(official_ten_split_s) |
        official_ten_split_s <= 0 ~
        "Invalid official testing result",

      !is.finite(mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw) ~
        "Invalid NFL movement summary",

      TRUE ~
        "Eligible"
    )
  )

modeling_eligibility <- analysis_roster |>
  count(
    draft_year,
    analysis_status,
    name = "players"
  )

print(modeling_eligibility, n = Inf)
```

```{r modeling-coverage}
modeling_coverage <- analysis_roster |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    combine_players = n(),

    players_with_measured_routes = sum(
      measured_route_count > 0L
    ),

    players_with_at_least_10_routes = sum(
      measured_route_count >= 10L
    ),

    players_with_at_least_20_routes = sum(
      measured_route_count >= 20L
    ),

    main_analysis_players = sum(
      analysis_status == "Eligible"
    ),

    eligible_with_two_combine_intervals = sum(
      analysis_status == "Eligible" &
        measured_combine_intervals >= 2L,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(modeling_coverage, width = Inf)

modeling_data <- analysis_roster |>
  filter(analysis_status == "Eligible")
```

## Define the model comparison

The response is player-level mean first-second speed gain on eligible rookie GO routes.

The primary comparison adds the mean Combine 3-7 speed interval to a baseline containing official 40, 10-yard split, and draft year.

Validation holds out players within each draft year. It evaluates additional players from represented classes, not forecasting a new draft class.

```{r preparing-model-input}
model_input <- modeling_data |>
  select(
    nfl_id,
    draft_year,
    official_forty_s,
    official_ten_split_s,
    mean_combine_interval_s,
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw
  ) |>
  mutate(
    draft_year = factor(draft_year)
  ) |>
  arrange(draft_year, nfl_id)

if (anyDuplicated(model_input$nfl_id) > 0L) {
  stop("Each player must have exactly one modeling row.")
}

numeric_columns <- c(
  "official_forty_s",
  "official_ten_split_s",
  "mean_combine_interval_s",
  "mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw"
)

if (anyNA(model_input) ||
    any(!is.finite(as.matrix(model_input[, numeric_columns])))) {
  stop("Missing or nonfinite model inputs.")
}

model_formulas <- list(
  "Year reference" =
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw ~ draft_year,

  "Baseline" =
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw ~
      official_forty_s +
      official_ten_split_s +
      draft_year,

  "Added interval" =
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw ~
      official_forty_s +
      official_ten_split_s +
      draft_year +
      mean_combine_interval_s
)
```

## Repeated player-level cross-validation

```{r cross-level-validation}
n_folds <- 5L
n_repeats <- 20L
cv_seed <- 2027L

if (any(table(model_input$draft_year) < n_folds)) {
  stop("A draft-year group is too small for the planned folds.")
}

set.seed(cv_seed)

prediction_results <- list()

for (repeat_id in seq_len(n_repeats)) {

  assigned_data <- model_input |>
    group_by(draft_year) |>
    mutate(
      fold_id = sample(
        rep(
          seq_len(n_folds),
          length.out = n()
        )
      )
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {

    training_data <- assigned_data |>
      filter(fold_id != fold)

    testing_data <- assigned_data |>
      filter(fold_id == fold)

    if (any(
      training_data$nfl_id %in% testing_data$nfl_id
    )) {
      stop("A player appears in both training and testing.")
    }

    for (model_name in names(model_formulas)) {

      fit <- lm(
        formula = model_formulas[[model_name]],
        data = training_data
      )

      if (fit$rank < ncol(model.matrix(fit))) {
        stop("A training model has redundant predictors. Review inputs.")
      }

      predictions <- as.numeric(
        predict(
          fit,
          newdata = testing_data
        )
      )

      if (any(!is.finite(predictions))) {
        stop("A model produced nonfinite predictions.")
      }

      prediction_results[[length(prediction_results) + 1L]] <-
        tibble(
          nfl_id = testing_data$nfl_id,
          draft_year = testing_data$draft_year,
          repeat_id = repeat_id,
          fold_id = fold,
          model = model_name,
          observed = testing_data$mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw,
          predicted = predictions
        )
    }
  }
}

held_out_predictions <- bind_rows(
  prediction_results
)
```

## Check prediction coverage

```{r prediction-coverage}
prediction_counts <- held_out_predictions |>
  count(
    nfl_id,
    repeat_id,
    model,
    name = "predictions"
  )

expected_predictions <- nrow(model_input) *
  n_repeats *
  length(model_formulas)

if (nrow(held_out_predictions) != expected_predictions ||
    any(prediction_counts$predictions != 1L)) {
  stop("Held-out prediction coverage is incorrect.")
}
```

## Compare held-out prediction errors

```{r comparing-model-orders}
cv_metrics <- held_out_predictions |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    players = n_distinct(nfl_id),

    rmse = sqrt(
      mean((observed - predicted)^2)
    ),

    mae = mean(
      abs(observed - predicted)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(cv_metrics, width = Inf)

baseline_rmse <- cv_metrics$rmse[
  cv_metrics$model == "Baseline"
]

expanded_rmse <- cv_metrics$rmse[
  cv_metrics$model == "Added interval"
]

primary_model_comparison <- tibble(
  players = nrow(model_input),
  baseline_rmse = baseline_rmse,
  expanded_rmse = expanded_rmse,
  rmse_gain = baseline_rmse - expanded_rmse,
  rmse_gain_pct =
    100 * (baseline_rmse - expanded_rmse) / baseline_rmse
)

print(primary_model_comparison, width = Inf)
```

## Conditional uncertainty in the error difference

```{r player-level-prediction-errors}
player_prediction_errors <- held_out_predictions |>
  group_by(draft_year, nfl_id) |>
  summarise(
    baseline_mse = mean(
      (
        observed[model == "Baseline"] -
          predicted[model == "Baseline"]
      )^2
    ),

    expanded_mse = mean(
      (
        observed[model == "Added interval"] -
          predicted[model == "Added interval"]
      )^2
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(!is.finite(
  as.matrix(
    player_prediction_errors[, c("baseline_mse", "expanded_mse")]
  )
))) {
  stop("Invalid player-level prediction errors.")
}
```

```{r paired-player-bootstrap}
bootstrap_reps <- 5000L
bootstrap_seed <- 2028L

year_indices <- split(
  seq_len(nrow(player_prediction_errors)),
  player_prediction_errors$draft_year,
  drop = TRUE
)

set.seed(bootstrap_seed)

bootstrap_rmse_gain <- replicate(
  bootstrap_reps,
  {

    sampled_indices <- unlist(
      lapply(
        year_indices,
        function(indices) {
          indices[
            sample.int(
              length(indices),
              size = length(indices),
              replace = TRUE
            )
          ]
        }
      ),
      use.names = FALSE
    )

    baseline_error <- sqrt(
      mean(
        player_prediction_errors$baseline_mse[
          sampled_indices
        ]
      )
    )

    expanded_error <- sqrt(
      mean(
        player_prediction_errors$expanded_mse[
          sampled_indices
        ]
      )
    )

    baseline_error - expanded_error
  }
)

conditional_error_interval <- tibble(
  players = nrow(player_prediction_errors),

  observed_rmse_gain =
    sqrt(mean(player_prediction_errors$baseline_mse)) -
    sqrt(mean(player_prediction_errors$expanded_mse)),

  conditional_gain_p025 = unname(
    quantile(bootstrap_rmse_gain, 0.025)
  ),

  conditional_gain_p975 = unname(
    quantile(bootstrap_rmse_gain, 0.975)
  )
)

print(conditional_error_interval, width = Inf)
```

## Exposure and recording-count sensitivities

```{r sensitivity-validation-function}
evaluate_model_set <- function(
    data,
    formulas,
    n_folds = 5L,
    n_repeats = 20L,
    seed = 2027L) {

  required_variables <- unique(
    unlist(
      lapply(formulas, all.vars)
    )
  )

  input <- data |>
    select(
      all_of(
        unique(
          c(
            "nfl_id",
            "draft_year",
            required_variables
          )
        )
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      draft_year = factor(draft_year)
    ) |>
    arrange(draft_year, nfl_id)

  if (anyNA(input) ||
      anyDuplicated(input$nfl_id) > 0L ||
      any(table(input$draft_year) < n_folds)) {
    stop("Review sensitivity inputs or fold sizes.")
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  results <- list()

  for (repeat_id in seq_len(n_repeats)) {

    assigned <- input |>
      group_by(draft_year) |>
      mutate(
        fold_id = sample(
          rep(
            seq_len(n_folds),
            length.out = n()
          )
        )
      ) |>
      ungroup()

    for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {

      train <- assigned |>
        filter(fold_id != fold)

      test <- assigned |>
        filter(fold_id == fold)

      if (any(train$nfl_id %in% test$nfl_id)) {
        stop("Train/test player overlap.")
      }

      for (model_name in names(formulas)) {

        fit <- lm(
          formulas[[model_name]],
          data = train
        )

        if (fit$rank < ncol(model.matrix(fit))) {
          stop("A sensitivity model has redundant predictors.")
        }

        prediction <- as.numeric(
          predict(fit, newdata = test)
        )

        if (any(!is.finite(prediction))) {
          stop("Nonfinite sensitivity predictions.")
        }

        results[[length(results) + 1L]] <- tibble(
          nfl_id = test$nfl_id,
          draft_year = test$draft_year,
          repeat_id = repeat_id,
          fold_id = fold,
          model = model_name,
          observed = test$mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw,
          predicted = prediction
        )
      }
    }
  }

  predictions <- bind_rows(results)

  coverage <- predictions |>
    count(
      nfl_id,
      repeat_id,
      model,
      name = "prediction_count"
    )

  expected <- nrow(input) *
    n_repeats *
    length(formulas)

  if (nrow(predictions) != expected ||
      any(coverage$prediction_count != 1L)) {
    stop("Incorrect sensitivity prediction coverage.")
  }

  metrics <- predictions |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(
      players = n_distinct(nfl_id),
      rmse = sqrt(
        mean((observed - predicted)^2)
      ),
      mae = mean(
        abs(observed - predicted)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    metrics = metrics,
    predictions = predictions
  )
}
```

```{r run-sample-sensitivities}

  "At least 20 NFL routes" = modeling_data |>
    filter(measured_route_count >= 20L),

sensitivity_runs <- lapply(
  sensitivity_cohorts,
  function(cohort) {

      data = cohort,
      formulas = model_formulas
    )
  }
)
```

```{r summarize-sample-sensitivities}
all_analysis_metrics <- bind_rows(

sample_sensitivity_summary <- all_analysis_metrics |>
  group_by(analysis) |>
  summarise(
    players = first(players),

      model == "Year reference"

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(sample_sensitivity_summary, width = Inf)
```

## Route-context sensitivity

```{r context-model-formulas}
context_formulas <- list(
  "Year reference" =
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw ~ draft_year,

  "Baseline" =
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw ~
      official_forty_s +
      official_ten_split_s +
      draft_year +
      mean_snap_speed_raw +
      slot_route_share,

  "Added interval" =
    mean_nfl_speed_gain_raw ~
      official_forty_s +
      official_ten_split_s +
      draft_year +
      mean_snap_speed_raw +
      slot_route_share +
      mean_combine_interval_s
)
```

```{r evaluate-context-models}
context_run <- evaluate_model_set(
  data = modeling_data,
  formulas = context_formulas
)

context_metrics <- context_run$metrics

print(context_metrics, width = Inf)

context_baseline_rmse <- context_metrics$rmse[
  context_metrics$model == "Baseline"
]

context_expanded_rmse <- context_metrics$rmse[
  context_metrics$model == "Added interval"
]

context_comparison <- tibble(
  analysis = "Route-context sensitivity",
  players = nrow(modeling_data),
  baseline_rmse = context_baseline_rmse,
  expanded_rmse = context_expanded_rmse,
  rmse_gain = context_baseline_rmse - context_expanded_rmse
)

print(context_comparison, width = Inf)
```

## NFL translation findings

The primary analysis included 53 receivers with at least 10 measured rookie-season GO routes and at least one measured Combine interval.

Adding the Combine 3-7 speed interval increased held-out RMSE by approximately 0.00875. The conditional paired-player bootstrap interval for RMSE improvement was approximately [-0.0135, -0.00481], favoring the baseline under that calculation.

The added interval also increased error when requiring at least 20 NFL routes, requiring two measured Combine intervals, and adjusting for mean snap speed and slot-route share.

The context-adjusted baseline outperformed the year-only reference. The traditional-testing baseline without those context variables did not.

These results describe retrospective movement prediction within represented draft classes. They do not test peak-acceleration timing, overall route-running quality, or NFL success. Route-context adjustment remains limited, and the bootstrap conditions on fixed held-out predictions.

```{r save-nfl-results}
    routes = "GO; WR or SLOT_WR alignment; explicitly no motion; not nullified",
    outcome = "Supplied speed at one second minus supplied speed at snap",
    timing = "Unique snap and pass events; pass at or after one second",

    primary_feature = "Mean available measured Combine 3-7 interval",
```
